lines.zh: 岛上的石头被晒得发烫，正好走。
lines.en: The island stones are hot from the sun, perfect for walking.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在身后，扫过一层沙。
lines.en: My tail drags behind me, sweeping a line in the sand.

lines.zh: 爬过倒下的椰子树，慢慢来。
lines.en: Climbing over the fallen palm, slowly does it.

lines.zh: 喉扇抖两下，是在量体温。
lines.en: My dewlap flicks twice, checking my body heat.

lines.zh: 这条小路通向最暖的那块岩。
lines.en: This little path leads to the warmest rock.

lines.zh: 爪子抓得牢，斜坡也上得去。
lines.en: My claws hold well, so I can take the slope.

lines.zh: 走过草丛，鳞片蹭得沙沙响。
lines.en: Walking through grass, my scales rustle softly.

lines.zh: 热带的光太强，走阴影那边。
lines.en: The tropical light is harsh; I take the shaded side.

lines.zh: 一步一步，不着急去哪儿。
lines.en: One step at a time, in no hurry to be anywhere.

lines.zh: 踩到自己的尾巴，回头看一眼。
lines.en: I stepped on my own tail and looked back at it.

lines.zh: 海风从岛的背面吹过来。
lines.en: The sea wind comes around the back of the island.

lines.zh: 这些石头缝里能藏半条腿。
lines.en: These rock cracks can hide half a leg.

lines.zh: 往上爬一点，视野更好。
lines.en: Climb a little higher for a better view.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖扫掉身后的脚印。
lines.en: My tail tip wipes away the footprints behind me.

lines.zh: 爪子扣住岩缝，往上挪一寸。
lines.en: My claws catch a crack and I inch upward.

lines.zh: 沙地烫脚，我挑阴凉那侧。
lines.en: The sand burns my feet, so I take the shaded side.

lines.zh: 趴着不动，让太阳烤背。
lines.en: Lying still, letting the sun bake my back.

lines.zh: 鳞片缝里暖起来，很舒服。
lines.en: Warmth seeps between my scales, and it feels good.

lines.zh: 喉扇张到最大，散热最快。
lines.en: Dewlap fully spread releases heat fastest.

lines.zh: 背上的果子，应该快熟了。
lines.en: The fruit on my back should be nearly cooked.

lines.zh: 眨眼很慢，因为不着急。
lines.en: I blink slowly because there is no rush.

lines.zh: 一只虫爬过前爪，懒得动。
lines.en: A bug crossed my front claw, and I could not be bothered.

lines.zh: 阳光的角度变了，挪半尺。
lines.en: The sun angle shifted, so I move half a foot.

lines.zh: 把身体压平，贴在石头上。
lines.en: Press my body flat against the stone.

lines.zh: 舌头卷一下，尝到空气里的咸。
lines.en: One flick of the tongue tastes salt in the air.

lines.zh: 尾巴慢慢摆，像在打拍子。
lines.en: My tail sways slowly, as if keeping time.

lines.zh: 有片叶子落在鼻尖上。
lines.en: A leaf landed right on the tip of my snout.

lines.zh: 闭眼听海浪，一遍又一遍。
lines.en: Eyes closed, listening to the waves, over and over.

lines.zh: 肚子贴着热石头，暖到骨头。
lines.en: Belly on hot stone, warm down to the bone.

lines.zh: 这个位置晒得到下午。
lines.en: This spot keeps the sun until afternoon.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在石头上，等风。
lines.en: I rest my chin on the stone and wait for the wind.

lines.zh: 喉咙里咕的一声，纯属习惯。
lines.en: A small click in my throat, purely habit.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，影子压到我。
lines.en: You stand too close; your shadow falls on me.

lines.zh: 抬眼看你，脖子上的皮皱起来。
lines.en: Looking up at you wrinkles the skin on my neck.

lines.zh: 你要不要也坐下来晒一会儿？
lines.en: Would you like to sit and bask a while too?

lines.zh: 我不跑，因为跑也跑不过你。
lines.en: I will not run, since I could not outrun you anyway.

lines.zh: 你的手上有果子味吗？
lines.en: Do your hands smell of fruit?

lines.zh: 幼时你帮我撕过旧皮，我记得。
lines.en: As a hatchling you peeled my old skin; I remember.

lines.zh: 别摸头，鳞片会被摸乱。
lines.en: Do not pat my head; you will muss the scales.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是在对准你的方向。
lines.en: My head tilt is me aiming at your direction.

lines.zh: 喉扇张开，不是要咬你。
lines.en: My dewlap spreading does not mean I will bite.

lines.zh: 你挡住风了，正好凉快。
lines.en: You are blocking the wind, which is nicely cool.

lines.zh: 我在数你站了几分钟。
lines.en: I am counting how many minutes you have stood there.

lines.zh: 眼睛半闭，但我看得见你。
lines.en: My eyes are half closed, but I still see you.

lines.zh: 鳞片裂了，晒着更疼。
lines.en: A scale cracked, and the sun makes it hurt more.

lines.zh: 尾巴被踩住，我只好脱开。
lines.en: With my tail pinned, I had to let it go.

lines.zh: 这一下打在背上，闷闷地疼。
lines.en: That landed on my back with a dull ache.

lines.zh: 我缩进石缝，等疼过去。
lines.en: I squeeze into a rock crack and wait for the pain to pass.

lines.zh: 喉扇垂下来，没力气张。
lines.en: My dewlap droops; I have no strength to flare it.

lines.zh: 走路一拐，尾巴拖得更重。
lines.en: I limp, and my tail drags heavier.

lines.zh: 皮破了，得找太阳晒一晒。
lines.en: The skin is broken; I need sun on it.

lines.zh: 被撞得头晕，趴着不动。
lines.en: The blow left me dizzy, so I lie still.

lines.zh: 这点伤，晒两天就好。
lines.en: This wound will heal after two days of sun.

lines.zh: 别碰伤口，鳞片会掉。
lines.en: Do not touch the wound; the scales will fall off.

lines.zh: 那片叶子在动，是你要给我？
lines.en: That leaf is moving; are you offering it to me?

lines.zh: 熟透的果子，甜味飘过来了。
lines.en: A ripe fruit's sweetness is drifting over.

lines.zh: 先闻一闻，再决定吃不吃。
lines.en: I sniff first, then decide whether to eat.

lines.zh: 别拿花晃，我够不着。
lines.en: Stop waving the flower; I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 仙人掌果也行，我不挑。
lines.en: Cactus fruit will do too; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 叶子要嫩的，老的嚼不动。
lines.en: The leaf must be tender; old ones are tough.

lines.zh: 你放低一点，我懒得抬头。
lines.en: Lower it a bit; I am too lazy to lift my head.

lines.zh: 这一口很慢，我嚼得久。
lines.en: This bite is slow; I chew for a long time.

lines.zh: 吃完了，能再晒一会儿吗？
lines.en: Once I finish, may I bask a while longer?

lines.zh: 果子汁水顺下巴流下去了。
lines.en: Fruit juice is running down my chin.

lines.zh: 闻起来像雨后的岛。
lines.en: It smells like the island after rain.

lines.zh: 我不抢，你放地上就好。
lines.en: I will not snatch; just put it on the ground.

lines.zh: 这一片够我嚼半天。
lines.en: This one leaf will keep me chewing for ages.

lines.zh: 你的影子跟着食物一起过来。
lines.en: Your shadow arrives together with the food.

lines.zh: 花递这么高，我得伸直脖子。
lines.en: You hold the flower that high, so I stretch my neck.

lines.zh: 我咬一口，抬头看你还给不给。
lines.en: I take a bite, then look up to see if there's more.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴了，很长的。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail, and it is very long.

lines.zh: 撞一下没关系，我皮厚。
lines.en: A bump is fine; my hide is thick.

lines.zh: 我被撞得滑下石头，又爬上来。
lines.en: Knocked off the rock, I climbed back up.

lines.zh: 让开半步，我要晒那块地。
lines.en: Move half a step; I want that sunny patch.

lines.zh: 你的靴子比我还高，撞不过。
lines.en: Your boot is taller than I am; I cannot win that.

lines.zh: 鳞片被蹭花了，得晒回来。
lines.en: My scales got scuffed and need sun to recover.

lines.zh: 撞到椰子壳，声音很响。
lines.en: I bumped a coconut shell and it rang loudly.

lines.zh: 我退开，是不想费力气。
lines.en: I back away because I do not want to spend effort.

lines.zh: 尾巴被踩住，转身都难。
lines.en: With my tail pinned, I can hardly turn.

lines.zh: 下次从我前面绕，别从背上跨。
lines.en: Go around in front next time, not over my back.

lines.zh: 两块石头之间，正好做窝。
lines.en: The gap between two rocks makes a fine nest.

lines.zh: 我挖的沙坑，深度刚好。
lines.en: The sand pit I dug is just the right depth.

lines.zh: 你先晒暖，再过来。
lines.en: Warm yourself in the sun first, then come over.

lines.zh: 尾巴绕在一起，别用力。
lines.en: Our tails twine together; do not pull.

lines.zh: 喉扇张给你看，颜色最亮。
lines.en: I spread my dewlap for you, brightest color.

lines.zh: 蛋要埋在向阳的沙里。
lines.en: The eggs must be buried in sun-facing sand.

lines.zh: 这个岛不大，够我们俩。
lines.en: This island is small, but enough for the two of us.

lines.zh: 一起守着沙坑，别让蟹来。
lines.en: Guard the sand pit together; keep the crabs out.

lines.zh: 你慢，我也慢，正好。
lines.en: You are slow and I am slow; that suits us.

lines.zh: 晒着同一块石头，就算一家人。
lines.en: Basking on the same rock makes us family.

lines.zh: 抱起来的时候，尾巴垂着。
lines.en: When lifted, my tail hangs straight down.

lines.zh: 托住肚子，那里最软。
lines.en: Support my belly; that part is softest.

lines.zh: 别抓尾巴，会断的。
lines.en: Do not grab the tail; it can break off.

lines.zh: 我趴在你手臂上，像块暖石头。
lines.en: I lie on your arm like a warm stone.

lines.zh: 离地这么高，我爪子张开。
lines.en: This high off the ground, my claws spread.

lines.zh: 你身上没有太阳，凉。
lines.en: There is no sun on you, and it is cool.

lines.zh: 放我到那块平石上，谢谢。
lines.en: Set me on that flat stone, thank you.

lines.zh: 我挣得不多，因为懒得挣。
lines.en: I barely struggle, because struggling is tiring.

lines.zh: 手心的温度，比石头差一点。
lines.en: Your palm's warmth is a bit less than stone.

lines.zh: 到了新地方，先看有没有太阳。
lines.en: In a new place, I check for sunlight first.

lines.zh: 有只蟹在沙坑边上，注意它。
lines.en: A crab is at the edge of the sand pit; watch it.

lines.zh: 背上的鳞片立了一点，是警觉。
lines.en: The scales on my back lift slightly; that is alertness.

lines.zh: 那影子不像海鸟，太大了。
lines.en: That shadow is too big to be a seabird.

lines.zh: 它离蛋太近了，我得过去。
lines.en: It is too near the eggs; I have to go over.

lines.zh: 喉扇沉下来，颜色变暗。
lines.en: My dewlap drops and its color darkens.

lines.zh: 草丛里有东西在慢慢挪。
lines.en: Something in the grass is moving slowly.

lines.zh: 先站起来，让它看见我的大小。
lines.en: Stand up first, so it sees my size.

lines.zh: 尾巴敲了一下石头，是提醒。
lines.en: My tail tapped the stone as a warning.

lines.zh: 它要是再靠近，我就张嘴。
lines.en: If it comes closer, I will open my mouth.

lines.zh: 太阳底下，我的影子很清楚。
lines.en: In this sun my shadow is very clear.

lines.zh: 绕到它和蛋之间，挡住路。
lines.en: Move between it and the eggs to block the way.

lines.zh: 压低身子，慢慢逼近。
lines.en: Lower my body and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 张嘴，把喉扇撑开吓它。
lines.en: Open my mouth and flare my dewlap to scare it.

lines.zh: 它退一步，我就进一步。
lines.en: It steps back; I step forward.

lines.zh: 不追远，守住这块沙就行。
lines.en: I will not chase far; holding this sand is enough.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩起来，声音像鞭子。
lines.en: My tail whips out, sounding like a lash.

lines.zh: 它要是咬，我就往石缝钻。
lines.en: If it bites, I will slip into a rock crack.

lines.zh: 盯着它的钳子，那里最危险。
lines.en: I watch its claws; that is the dangerous part.

lines.zh: 等它先出手，我才好躲。
lines.en: I wait for it to strike first so I can dodge.

lines.zh: 脚爪抓稳，别被拖下去。
lines.en: Claws gripping firm so I am not dragged off.

lines.zh: 尾巴横扫，先打它的腿。
lines.en: A tail sweep goes for its legs first.

lines.zh: 咬住不放，虽然牙不算利。
lines.en: I bite and hold, though my teeth are not sharp.

lines.zh: 爪子按住，让它翻不过来。
lines.en: Pinning it down with my claws so it cannot right itself.

lines.zh: 甩头，把它丢出去。
lines.en: Twist my head and fling it away.

lines.zh: 它夹我尾巴，我转身就咬。
lines.en: It pinched my tail, so I turned and bit.

lines.zh: 这一口很慢，但很沉。
lines.en: This bite is slow but heavy.

lines.zh: 打一下，退回石头后面。
lines.en: Strike once, then retreat behind the rock.

lines.zh: 用背甲挡，鳞片很硬。
lines.en: I block with my back; the scales are hard.

lines.zh: 它跑了，我不追太远。
lines.en: It fled, and I will not chase too far.

lines.zh: 喘口气，喉扇还在抖。
lines.en: Catching my breath, dewlap still trembling.

lines.zh: 从沙里钻出来，满身是沙。
lines.en: I dug out of the sand covered in it.

lines.zh: 第一眼看到的是椰子树的影子。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was a palm tree's shadow.

lines.zh: 太阳很亮，我先眯起眼。
lines.en: The sun is bright, so I squint first.

lines.zh: 蛋壳还粘在背上，得蹭掉。
lines.en: Eggshell is stuck to my back; I need to rub it off.

lines.zh: 这片沙滩是新的，得认路。
lines.en: This beach is new; I must learn the paths.

lines.zh: 尾巴比身体还长一点。
lines.en: My tail is a little longer than my body.

lines.zh: 爬两步，歇一会儿。
lines.en: Two steps, then a short rest.

lines.zh: 海水的声音在左边。
lines.en: The sound of the sea is on my left.

lines.zh: 身上还是软的，得晒硬。
lines.en: My body is still soft and needs the sun to harden.

lines.zh: 先找块石头，站高一点。
lines.en: First find a stone and stand a bit higher.

lines.zh: 太烫了，石头都在冒烟。
lines.en: Too hot; even the stones are smoking.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下来，肚子先着地。
lines.en: Falling from a height, I landed on my belly.

lines.zh: 海水灌进嘴里，我拼命划。
lines.en: Seawater filled my mouth and I paddled desperately.

lines.zh: 沙子炸起来，埋了我半个身子。
lines.en: Sand blew up and half buried me.

lines.zh: 有东西钉进尾巴，甩不掉。
lines.en: Something is stuck in my tail and I cannot shake it off.

lines.zh: 鳞片忽然发冷，太阳也不管用。
lines.en: My scales went cold, and the sun does not help.

lines.zh: 好几天没吃到叶子，肚子瘪了。
lines.en: Days without leaves have left my belly sunken.

lines.zh: 雷打在岛上，我整条都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the island and my whole body seized.

lines.zh: 脚下没有沙，也没有石头。
lines.en: There is no sand under me, no stone either.
